<thought>We need to provide the mapped_rxn for the Wolff‑Kishner reduction template. The forward reaction converts a ketone (C=O) into an alkane (C‑C). A simple SMARTS representation of this transformation is “[C:1](=O)[C:2]>>[C:1][C:2]”. This is the mapped reaction string to return.</thought>
<final_answer>["[C:1](=O)[C:2]>>[C:1][C:2]"]</final_answer>
